description: The quotient-plus-default carrier built from a finite retained term set is finite, including when the set is empty.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.finite_carrier.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L))
  (E : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) (hE : E ⊆ S.product S) :
  Finite (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.Carrier S E hE)
